description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper' used for retrieving and aggregating status and health information of a distributed cluster, specifically within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles communication with cluster nodes to gather status and health data, processes role expectations, and constructs JSON reports of cluster health and status.

classes.name: ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper
classes.description: A utility class for retrieving and processing the status and health information of a distributed cluster, leveraging Akka for communication with cluster nodes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ClusterStatusAndHealthHelper with provided ActorSystem, cluster state supplier, and health check configuration.

methods.name: retrieveOverallRolesStatus
methods.description: Fetches static status information from each reachable cluster member, organizing data by role, and returning a JSON object with roles as keys.

methods.name: retrieveOverallRolesHealth
methods.description: Retrieves health information from each reachable cluster node, considering role expectations, and returns a StatusInfo object summarizing cluster health.

methods.name: sendCommandToRemoteAddresses
methods.description: Sends a specified command via Akka to a set of remote addresses and transforms responses using a provided transformer function.
